_analytic._v7_changes: Mode 5 v7 (2026-04-24): killed 1000-card weight per user brief "1000倍以上的奖需要趋近于0". Previously P(1000) = 0.19% per pick, giving P(session R≥1000) = 1% per triggered session = 1/3616 per paid spin. v7 drops P(1000) per pick to effectively 0 (0.00%), making session R>=1000 occur at 1/7.6M per paid spin. The 1000 cards EV contribution (~10-15pp) redistributed mostly to 100-card (weight 1.6065→4.5, per-value prob 1.61%→4.34%). Net EV drops 132.00→132.81 (rebounds due to more 100-sum combos filling the gap). Total RTP lands 500.29pp exactly on target.
